panels.description: Tomas leads Alex and Ada to an older service wall marked with the balanced water-drop. Leave upper wall space.
The heavy old key enters an unwired mechanical lock. Leave the key and lock clear.
Tomas creates a credible worksite distraction at the main gate while Alex, Ada and folded Bi11bot prepare at the old door. Leave upper worksite space.
The old door opens; Alex and Ada slip through while Tomas remains behind. Leave upper doorway space.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: Adrian asked me to keep this closed.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: From anyone who came for the work.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: Foreman! Your safety report is on fire.
